sentences.quote: roughly $10 billion of a $13.5 billion gross cost-savings target delivered
sentences.text: Cost synergies keep building, with cumulative gross cost savings of USD 11.5bn at the end of the first quarter of 2026 against the 2022 combined cost base, versus an ambition of around USD 13bn by the end of 2026.
Profitability is recovering toward management's targets of around 15% underlying return on CET1 capital and a cost-income ratio below 70% on exit from 2026.
Capital returns rest on a strong balance sheet, with a 14.4% CET1 ratio, accrual for mid-teens dividend growth and a further USD 3bn buyback program.
